content: This medication may lead to a condition called ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), which can occur during or after treatment. In rare cases, severe OHSS can result in the rapid accumulation of fluid in the abdomen, chest, and heart areas. Severe allergic reactions to this drug are uncommon. This is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. In the United States, consult your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Before using cetrorelix, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other products containing gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other issues. Discontinue this medication if you become pregnant, as it must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Due to potential risks to the infant, breastfeeding is not recommended while using this medication. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. While using this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., vaginal ultrasound, hormone levels) may be conducted. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, consult your doctor or pharmacist promptly for a new dosing schedule. Different brands of this medication may have varying storage requirements. Refer to the product package for storage instructions or ask your pharmacist. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
